846.text: Basing itself on Scripture and Tradition, the Council teaches that the Church, a pilgrim now on earth, is necessary for salvation: the one Christ is the mediator and the way of salvation; he is present to us in his body which is the Church.
846.notes: Quoted sentence only. Quoting Lumen Gentium 14. Para. opens: all salvation comes from Christ the Head through the Church which is his Body. Ch. 12 line 121.
